common.selection: Finish current cast; evaluate setup/combos, then ready non-filler damaging abilities by descending damage per activation, then filler, then auto-attack. Do not choose zero-CD filler before ready stronger abilities.

common.randomEffects: No random crit, misses, control procs or chance-based bonus damage. Guaranteed crit only.
common.resourceGates: Do not cast unaffordable skills or health-sacrifice skills whose health condition fails.
common.timeHorizon: Count impacts at t < 600 only, not future damage already launched.
